# Xvesting

> AI-powered investment intelligence for institutional and professional investors. Real-time market data, AI-driven research tools, smart portfolios, and an autonomous AI agent that analyzes markets — all in one platform.

Xvesting is a fintech platform that combines proprietary AI with deep financial data infrastructure to help investment professionals make faster, better-informed decisions. The platform processes public and private data sources at scale — SEC filings, earnings transcripts, broker research, internal Excel models, and more — and surfaces investment-grade insights with full citation traceability.

## Core capabilities

- **AI market agent**: An autonomous agent that answers complex investment questions, synthesizes research from 100,000+ sources, and generates auditable, citation-grounded answers.
- **Proprietary data ingestion**: Upload internal data — spreadsheets, memos, models — and query it alongside public sources in one unified search.
- **Real-time market intelligence**: Live feeds spanning equities, macro, and crypto with relevance-ranked signal scoring.
- **Report generation**: Investment memos, earnings summaries, and Q&A prep generated in seconds with traceable sourcing.
- **Enterprise security**: SOC 2 Type II audited, AES-256 encryption at rest and in transit, zero model training on client data, admin governance and permissions.

## Research

Xvesting publishes original technical research on AI architecture, financial NLP, market microstructure, and data infrastructure. Papers are authored by the Xvesting Research Team and Xvesting Infrastructure Team.

- Citation-Grounded Retrieval for Investment Research (August 2026) — RAG architecture for auditable AI answers with 94.7% citation accuracy.
- Hierarchical Document Indexing at Cell Granularity (July 2026) — Cell-level financial table indexing improving retrieval precision by 34%.
- Latency and Alpha: Information Decay Rate of Earnings Call Transcripts (June 2026) — Quantified alpha decay curve showing 73% of signal captured within 8 minutes.
- Multi-Tenant Vector Store Isolation (May 2026) — Security and performance trade-offs across three isolation architectures.
- Domain Adaptation of LLMs for Investment Research: FinBench-TX (April 2026) — 2,400-task benchmark study comparing frontier models against CFA charterholder baselines.
- Agentic Research Workflows for Investment Diligence (March 2026) — DAG-based task decomposition reducing hallucination rate from 18.7% to 2.9%.
